findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：3M 2025 年約 56% 營收來自美國以外，並明列美中貿易緊張升級可能對業務造成重大不利影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: During 2025, the Company derived approximately 56 percent of its revenues from outside the United States.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：美國及其他政府已實施並擬再實施出口管制與關稅，可能造成供應鏈中斷（含稀土取得受限）、生產成本與產品定價上升。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The U.S. and other governments have imposed, and propose to impose additional, export controls and tariffs on certain products, and financial and economic sanctions on certain industry sectors and parties.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K MD&A：2025 年銷貨成本率上升部分來自關稅；營業利益率受關稅衝擊部分抵銷。
findings.excerpt: Increases in 2025 were primarily due to foreign currency impacts; tariffs; the exit of manufactured PFAS products;

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：原料端關稅造成供給緊縮與通膨，但以議價供應合約與規模抵銷。
findings.excerpt: Overall, these market conditions caused supply constraints and inflation, but were offset via negotiated supply contracts and leveraging scale across the supply base.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 3M 專屬的 2026 Section 232 或實體清單資料；2025 年 Q1 關稅估計見 clues。

clues.claim: 2025 年 4 月 3M 估計年化關稅衝擊約 8.5 億美元（美中關稅占 6.75 億），中國約占進口 10%、出口略高於 10%。
